faq.subheadline: Everything you need to know about City Gate Capital. Can't find an answer?

items.a: City Gate Capital uses account-security controls including multi-factor authentication and protected sessions. Financial, custody and investment services are available only through eligible accounts and approved providers.

items.q: What happens if I lose access to my account?
items.a: Use the secure password-reset journey or contact support. Additional identity checks may be required before account access is restored.

items.q: How quickly can I open an account?
items.a: Registration takes only a few minutes. Final account activation depends on identity verification, eligibility, jurisdiction and approved provider coverage.

items.q: What currencies and crypto do you support?
items.a: Available fiat currencies and digital assets are shown in your account. Coverage depends on approved providers, account eligibility and jurisdiction.
Any applicable plan fee is disclosed before you choose or activate an account plan. Available services and pricing may vary by eligibility and jurisdiction.

items.q: Are there hidden fees on transfers?
items.a: Applicable transfer fees, exchange rates and spreads are displayed before an eligible transfer is authorized.
Choose an eligible account and recipient, enter the amount, review the rate and fees, complete security verification, and follow the transfer status. Availability depends on the route and provider.

items.q: Can I schedule or automate recurring transfers?
items.a: Scheduled and recurring transfers appear when supported for your account, currency and payment route. Review all details before authorization.
